summary: Complaints centre on erratic power (10 to 12 hours of cuts a day in Dibai, repeated tripping, unannounced outages), waterlogging in Dibai's market after rain and an incomplete bypass; the verified appreciations are a 150-couple mass-marriage event and a quick restoration after a sub-station VCB fire, and the remaining positives are thin and flagged.

positives.english: Sugar mills have sent the full cane payment into farmers' accounts
positives.hindi: चीनी मिलों ने गन्ने का पूरा पैसा किसानों के खाते में भेज दिया
positives.basis: District-level, not Dibai-specific: ChiniMandi (8 Jul 2026) says the four Bulandshahr mills of the 2025-26 season (Sabitgarh; Anamika at Agauta; Wave at Bulandshahr; Di Kisan at Anupshahr) have sent 100% of the payment for cane bought to farmers' bank accounts, total Rs 1,09,209.12 lakh. The article does not mention Dibai or any mill in Dibai

positives.english: Power came back in about three hours after the VCB fire
positives.hindi: वीसीबी जली तो भी करीब तीन घंटे में बिजली लौट आई
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026): a technical fault set fire to a VCB machine around 10:24 PM on the Monday night, cutting supply in Dibai for about three hours; power returned once the fault was fixed. Dibai consumers had faced low voltage, tripping and undeclared cuts for the three days before it. A single restoration, not a lasting fix

positives.english: 150 couples were married under the state mass-marriage scheme in Dibai
positives.hindi: डिबाई में सामूहिक विवाह योजना से 150 शादियां हुईं
positives.basis: Janmat News (19 Feb 2026): a mass-marriage event under the Chief Minister's Samuhik Vivah scheme was held at Ravan ki Patwari in Dibai nagar, with 150 weddings. The article does not say how many couples were from Dibai, so this is a scheme event held in Dibai, not a count of Dibai beneficiaries

positives.english: *Farmers can sell their crop at the Dibai mandi
positives.hindi: *डिबाई की मंडी में किसान अपनी फसल बेच पाते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026) names Mandi Hardev as a spot where waterlogging blocked traffic in Dibai, which implies a mandi operates there; no source found on crop sales, procurement or prices at the Dibai mandi (searches this round returned only other districts). Field check needed

positives.english: *Dibai has a government hospital people can use for treatment
positives.hindi: *डिबाई में सरकारी अस्पताल में इलाज होता है
positives.basis: Inference: a search result listed a Community Health Centre Dibai on the Bulandshahr district hospital page, but that page returned HTTP 503 when fetched, so it is not cited. No 2026 report on services at the Dibai facility was found. Field check needed; replaces an earlier tehsil-office item, which was a geography fact and not a benefit

negatives.english: Power is cut for 10 to 12 hours a day in Dibai
negatives.hindi: डिबाई में रोज़ 10 से 12 घंटे बिजली कटती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (13 Jul 2026): a table of daily average outage hours gives Dibai as 10 से 12 घंटे (Shikarpur, AC 69, is in the same table row and is not used here). The table sits in a report on a protest in Bulandshahr city, and the article also says most villages face 8 to 10 hours of daily cuts. Chief Engineer Sanjeev Kumar blamed higher summer load for the faults. Dibai is the namesake town of the AC, so it counts as inside the AC

negatives.english: Market shops in Dibai flood when it rains
negatives.hindi: डिबाई में बारिश हुई तो बाजार और दुकानों में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026): after about 45 minutes of heavy rain, Mahadev Chauraha, Paith Chauraha, Holi Gate and Bada Bazar had two to three feet of water, and shops on Railway Road were flooded. Shopkeepers were angry and councillors said shopkeepers have long demanded a fix; the EO and chairperson were asked to solve it. The article says the rain exposed the municipality's drainage claims. No official response is quoted

negatives.english: Power trips and goes off without notice in Dibai
negatives.hindi: डिबाई में बार-बार ट्रिपिंग और बिना बताए बिजली कटौती से परेशानी
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (1 Jul 2026): residents of Dibai faced unannounced cuts and repeated tripping for ten days; flour mills could not grind wheat and children's studies were affected. Trader representative Deepak Agarwal gave a memorandum to XEN Rahul Ratn Bodhi seeking advance notice of cuts. The XEN attributed the disruptions to transformer overloading, and the article says work is ongoing on feeders one and two

negatives.english: Dibai bypass is incomplete and highway jams happen in Dibai
negatives.hindi: डिबाई का बाईपास अधूरा पड़ा है और हाईवे पर जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 May 2025, district plan article): says the incomplete bypass in Dibai and Sikandarabad will be completed, and gives a 6.80 km Dibai bypass costing Rs 45.50 crore as a proposal; no work reported as started or complete, and the plans await government approval. Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026): people were stuck in highway jams in Dibai during the rain. No 2026 status report on the bypass was found, so 'incomplete' rests on the 2025 article

negatives.english: Garbage heaps line Bulandshahr streets in the morning
negatives.hindi: सुबह सड़कों पर कचरे के ढेर लगे मिलते हैं
negatives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2026), in an article on cleanliness in Bulandshahr, says garbage heaps are found on the streets in the morning. Dibai nagar palika is named only in a list of district bodies, with no Dibai-specific figure, so this is not counted in ac_specific_negatives

notes: Identity verified on the Wikipedia list (67 Anupshahr, 68 Debai, 69 Shikarpur; reservation None; Bulandshahr). Wikipedia Debai AC page: extent is Debai Tehsil, plus Bagsara, Bibiyana, Mau, Dubka, Suratgarh urf Lodhai and Rajour of Anupshahar KC. These are named in the extent text; none is used in an item. Named places used: Dibai town (namesake, inside), Mahadev Chauraha, Paith Chauraha, Holi Gate, Bada Bazar, Railway Road, Mandi Hardev (all reported as Dibai locations in the 2 Sep 2026 article), and Dibai nagar (venue in Janmat). The Bhimpur sub-station named in an earlier draft is not in the article and was removed. Power evidence is the strongest local story and is verified (Amar Ujala 30 Jun, 1 Jul and 13 Jul 2026). The 1 Jul and 13 Jul articles give residents' accounts and official explanations, not verified outage logs. Positive 1 (cane) is district-level. Positive 3 is a scheme event held in Dibai; the article does not say how many couples were from Dibai. Positives 4 and 5 are unsourced inferences and need a field check. The district hospital page returned HTTP 503 and was not cited. No 2026 bypass status report was found. Searches for Dibai mandi procurement, substation commissioning, road or drain completion, and a theft-recovery item returned nothing for Dibai. The 15-hour supply and inverter report from an earlier draft was not found and is not used.

round2.changes: Opened all 8 item URLs and the Wikipedia list and AC pages. Removed the unsourced 100-bed hospital and the Bhimpur sub-station name (not in the article). Replaced the tehsil-office positive (geography, not a benefit) with a flagged hospital inference. Added a sourced positive (Janmat, 19 Feb 2026, 150 weddings under the state scheme in Dibai nagar). Re-ranked positives: cane payment (district) 1, power restoration 2. Rewrote negative 4 to match the 2025 proposal status and negative 5 to say it is district-level. Corrected negative 2 basis (councillor and EO detail as stated). Negative 3 wording and the Wikipedia extent note were checked against the sources.
